EFT is the batched, low-cost rail: payments go in files and typically settle the next business day. A wire is sent individually, settles in near real time and costs more per transfer, which is why it's used for large or urgent amounts. So they aren't interchangeable in a deck: the speed, cost and when you can reverse a payment all differ. Action: Write a two-line definition you can paste into a comment on the sales deck.

For jammy yolks, lower cold eggs into boiling water for about 6.5 to 7 minutes, then straight into ice water for a few minutes so they peel cleanly. For ramen eggs, peel them and marinate in a soy, mirin and water mixture overnight, so tonight is the time to cook them. Action: Set a reminder for this evening to boil and marinate the eggs so they're ready for Leo tomorrow.
